sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording (refer Product Benefits Table)

room_rent.note: No cap on room rent; reasonable and necessary charges reimbursed. No proportionate deduction.

copayment.note: Mandatory 20% co-pay if insured is aged 61+ at Policy Inception Date. Zone-based co-pay also applicable. Optional cover 17 can waive mandatory co-pay.

sub_limits.note: Cataract: ₹50,000 per eye per Policy Year. Specified psychiatric disorders: ₹50,000 cumulative sub-limit with 36-month wait. IVF, Bariatric, Lasik, Psychiatric covered up to limits in Product Benefits Table.

deductible.note: Aggregate Deductible and Per Claim Deductible available as optional covers.

initial_waiting.note: Can be reduced to 7 days if opted. Optional cover 19 or 35 (Insta Cover) can reduce further.

ped_waiting.note: Optional cover 18 allows reduction. Insta Cover (optional cover 35) can reduce to Day 1 for declared/accepted conditions.

specific_disease_waiting.note: List of 17 conditions. Optional cover 28 allows reduction.

maternity.note: Available as Optional Cover 7 (48-month wait) or Optional Cover 30 (12-month wait, 3-yr policy only). Bonus Booster not available for Shield plan per Super Saver Pack terms.

cumulative_bonus.note: 20% of SI per year, max 100%. Bonus Booster not available for Shield plan.

restoration.note: 100% recharge unlimited times from 2nd claim onwards for unrelated illness/injury. Optional cover 13 extends to same/related illness.

pre_hosp.note: Super Saver Pack (optional cover 33) includes 60 days pre-hospitalisation for Shield plan. Base days per Product Benefits Table.

post_hosp.note: Super Saver Pack (optional cover 33) includes 180 days post-hospitalisation for Shield plan.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance per hospitalisation. Air ambulance as optional cover 16.

global_cover.note: Global Cover (optional cover 21) up to SI or ₹50L whichever lower. Worldwide Emergency Hospitalization (optional cover 10) up to 50% SI max ₹10L with ₹2L deductible.

grace_period.note: 15 days for monthly premium payment mode.

notable_exclusions: Sleep apnea, genetic/hereditary disorders, external congenital anomaly, dental (non-accident), OPD (unless optional), war/terrorism
optional_riders: Critical Illness lump sum, Personal Accident, Aggregate/Per Claim Deductible, Voluntary Co-pay, Maternity (48mo wait), OPD cover, Global cover, Air ambulance, Non-payable items, Recharge for same illness, Insta Cover, Super Saver Pack
